question: Which variant of the lithium iron aluminum nickelate (NFA) cathode had the lowest first-cycle discharge capacity, and what was it?
rendered:
Document: Lithium Iron Aluminum Nickelate, LiNixFeyAlzO2—New Sustainable Cathodes for Next-Generation Cobalt-Free Li-Ion Batteries

The variant with the lowest first-cycle discharge capacity was NFA-A, with a capacity of ≈192 mAh g^− 1.
